LESSON: PASSING LISTENING

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Passing LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Passing LISTENING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Listen to information attentively for effective communication in and out of class.
2. Experience pleasure in passing verbal messages in and out of class. be appreciated for passing messages effectively. dialogue with each other. conveying messages whenever an opportunity arises. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Listen to information attentively for effective communication in and out of class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to listen to information attentively for effective communication in and out of class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Experience pleasure in passing verbal messages in and out of class. be appreciated for passing messages effectively. dialogue with each other. conveying messages whenever an opportunity arises. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to experience pleasure in passing verbal messages in and out of class. be appreciated for passing messages effectively. dialogue with each other. conveying messages whenever an opportunity arises. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Passing LISTENING.
2. Explain Passing LISTENING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Passing LISTENING.
4. Show that you can: Listen to information attentively for effective communication in and out of class.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Passing LISTENING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Passing LISTENING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Listen to information attentively for effective communication in and out of class.
2. Experience pleasure in passing verbal messages in and out of class. be appreciated for passing messages effectively. dialogue with each other. conveying messages whenever an opportunity arises. Core-competence developed Communication and collaboration, learning to learn, digital literacy

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
